description: Land Acquisition - Aarabokka, Hambanthota D/S Division, Hambanthota District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, describing specific parcels of land to be acquired for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of 119 land lots with their boundaries, extents, and locations, but does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any other specialized category. The content fits precisely within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property matters.
